newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech IPS AGM approves CZK 3.5 1996 div.
newsitem.headline: Czech IPS AGM approves CZK 3.5 1996 div.

text.p: An annual general meeting of the largest Czech construction group, IPS a.s., agreed to pay a 1996 gross dividend of 3.5 crowns per share on 1996 net earnings of 79 million crowns, an IPS spokeswoman said.
The company did not pay a dividend on 1995 earnings.

The spokeswoman, Katerina Martinkova, told Reuters that IPS management expects net 1997 unconsolidated net profit to rise to 208 million crowns, growing to 245 million crowns in 1998, and 273 million crowns the following year.
The execution date for the dividend was not disclosed.
The main shareholders of IPS as of the end of May were the Czech fund SPIF Cesky with a 15 percent stake and fund IPF Komercni Banky with 13 percent.
